ext.description: Mirrors IBM i source members as local files through Code for IBM i, so AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, ...) and any other tool can work on them. Save = automatic upload.
cmd.compile: Compile current file on IBM i
cmd.uploadCurrent: Upload current file to IBM i
cmd.uploadFolder: Upload folder to IBM i (all members)
cfg.title: Bridge for IBM i
cfg.targetLibrary: Target library used when compiling (e.g. MYLIB)
cfg.mirrorFolder: Workspace folder where members are mirrored
cfg.autoUpload: Automatically upload to IBM i when a mirrored file changes
view.welcome:
No mirror folder in this workspace yet.
[Pull member(s) to workspace](command:bridgeForI.pull)
